title: 前台的新消息  (Message at the Front Desk)

segments.t: Ten minutes later, Qing and Manager Zhou hurry back through the courtyard gate into the cool front lobby, where Chen stands behind the desk tapping a yellow express envelope against his paper ledger. Listen first.
你们可算回来啦——是不是老板又带大家走厨房外头的著名近路了？
老陈，别提路线了！你手里那个黄信封是什么？！
车站快件，十一点四十签收的，那时候你们正追钟楼影子呢。
看左边寄件人那一行——是我们八号房的制图员寄的！
快拆，小晴，再不拆我的老花镜都要从鼻子上掉下来啦！
下个星期六到成都，来小院客栈过三十周年的五月纪念日！
下个星期六？！当年八号房的老客人要亲自来这儿？！
念最底下最后一行——那一句是留给厨房的。
真心盼着能尝一块著名的莓果杏仁蛋糕！
天哪，那张蛋糕菜谱我们现在只有上半截呀！
那还不赶紧上楼去四号房问问宋老师那本旧的绿花园书！
快上楼吧——离下个星期六只有七天了，烤箱正等着我们呢！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
你们可算回来啦——是不是老板又带大家走厨房外头的著名近路了？
'You took your time—did the boss try his famous alley shortcut past the kitchen?' "Kesuan" voices wry relief—"at long last!"—while "shibushi" checks a spot-on hunch: "don't tell me the boss...?"
老陈，别提路线了！你手里那个黄信封是什么？！
'Never mind the route, Chen! What is that yellow envelope in your hand?!' "Bie ti... le!" waves an embarrassing topic aside—"don't bring up the route!"—and "shouli" means "in your hand".
车站快件，十一点四十签收的，那时候你们正追钟楼影子呢。

'Express station post, signed for at eleven-forty while you were chasing clock shadows.' "Kuaijian" joins "fast" and "item" for an express dispatch, and "qianshou" pairs "sign" with "receive" for delivery sign-off.
看左边寄件人那一行——是我们八号房的制图员寄的！
'Look at the sender line on the left—it is from our Room Eight mapmaker!' "Jijianren" stacks "mail", "item", and "person" for the sender, framed by "shi... ji de" to spotlight who sent it.
快拆，小晴，再不拆我的老花镜都要从鼻子上掉下来啦！
'Open it, Qing, open it before my glasses fall right off my nose!' "Zai bu chai" warns "if you wait any longer to tear it open", and "diao xialai" pictures tumbling downward.
下个星期六到成都，来小院客栈过三十周年的五月纪念日！

'Arriving in Chengdu next Saturday for the thirtieth May anniversary at Courtyard Inn!' "Xia ge xingqiliu" literally says "down-one Saturday" along the calendar, and "zhounian" names a full-year anniversary.
下个星期六？！当年八号房的老客人要亲自来这儿？！
'Next Saturday?! The original guest from Room Eight is coming HERE in person?!' "Qinzi" means "in one's own person" rather than by letter or messenger—making Manager Zhou nearly leap behind the desk.
念最底下最后一行——那一句是留给厨房的。
'Read the last line at the bottom—that is the part for the kitchen.' "Liugei" fuses "keep" and "for" into one smooth action: "saved specifically for the kitchen".
真心盼着能尝一块著名的莓果杏仁蛋糕！
'Hoping with all my heart to taste one slice of that famous berry almond cake!' "Zhenxin" literally says "true-heart" for "with all my heart", paired with "panzhe", eagerly longing for a slice.
天哪，那张蛋糕菜谱我们现在只有上半截呀！
'Merciful heavens, we still only have the TOP HALF of that cake recipe!' "Zhiyou" means "only have", while "shangbanjie" vividly names the "upper half-section" of a torn page.
那还不赶紧上楼去四号房问问宋老师那本旧的绿花园书！
'Better go ask Teacher Song about that old green garden book in Room Four right now.' "Ganjin" urges "right away, lose no time", and doubling "wen" into "wenwen" keeps the question warm and polite.
快上楼吧——离下个星期六只有七天了，烤箱正等着我们呢！

'Up the stairs we go—next Saturday is seven days away, and the oven awaits!' "Li" measures distance in time or space—"from next Saturday, only seven days"—and "kaoxiang" pairs "bake" and "box" for oven.
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
你们可算回来啦——是不是老板又带大家走厨房外头的著名近路了？
老陈，别提路线了！你手里那个黄信封是什么？！
车站快件，十一点四十签收的，那时候你们正追钟楼影子呢。
看左边寄件人那一行——是我们八号房的制图员寄的！
快拆，小晴，再不拆我的老花镜都要从鼻子上掉下来啦！
下个星期六到成都，来小院客栈过三十周年的五月纪念日！
下个星期六？！当年八号房的老客人要亲自来这儿？！
念最底下最后一行——那一句是留给厨房的。
真心盼着能尝一块著名的莓果杏仁蛋糕！
天哪，那张蛋糕菜谱我们现在只有上半截呀！
那还不赶紧上楼去四号房问问宋老师那本旧的绿花园书！
快上楼吧——离下个星期六只有七天了，烤箱正等着我们呢！
The retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday in person—hoping for a cake whose second half is still missing! End of Episode 2—see you in Episode 3!
下次见！
